second_read.note: Independent second read of a QMBL-added row. Hamiltonian H = J1 sum_<i,j> S_i S_j + J2 sum_<<i,j>> S_i S_j with spin-1/2 operators (v1 Eq. 4, v2 Eq. 6), 'square lattice with periodic boundary conditions and N = 36, 64 and 100 spins 1/2'; Table I is per site in S.S units with J1 = 1 (the paper's own 6x6 ED column and its quoted Sandvik QMC cells fix it). Size, boundary and J2 agree with the instance; 'ViT' is a variational NQS, so bound_type variational is right; method_as_published 'ViT' is the column header; peer_reviewed false is right (no journal reference on the abs page, 2026-09-29); primary (column '(this work)'). Kind of number: the authors' extended data (2026-09-28) states that Table I lists the best of ten checkpoints (every 150 of 1500 epochs), each a 4096-sample estimate; no error bar is printed, so sigma stays null (RULES.md 6). energy_variance 0.352 = sigma^2 x 16 x 100 with sigma^2 = 2.200e-4 = (<H^2>-<H>^2)/N per spin (S.S units), authors' extended data row '0.20 -0.592982 2.3 0.22 -0.592982 2.3 0.22 -0.592930 0.625 0.22', column group 'the best epochs, 4096 samples; Table I'; V-score N Var/E^2 = 6.2566e-4 recomputes. Best checkpoint = final epoch (same 4096-sample energy in both column groups); the same state re-measured with 102,400 samples gives -0.592930 (error 6.25e-6), 5.20e-5 per site above the Table I value.
